content: Running out of space on your Nintendo Switch 2? Thankfully, Samsung’s P9 MicroSD Express card is discounted at multiple retailers, with the 256GB version going for $47.99 (Amazon, B&H Photo) and the 512GB version $99 (Amazon, B&H Photo). The smaller card typically sells for around $80, and the larger option usually sells between $150 and $200, though both are higher than their original launch prices, likely because of the ongoing memory shortage. [Product: Samsung P9 microSD Express Card | https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0FT99KCV8?tag=theverge02-20, https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0FT995SPF?tag=theverge02-20, https://go.skimresources.com/?id=87443X1797501&xs=1&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.bhphotovideo.com%2Fc%2Fproduct%2F1924975-REG%2Fsamsung_mb_mk256t_am_256gb_p9_microsd_express.html] First-party Switch 2 games generally run between 10 and 30 gigabytes each — the upcoming The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake is 27GB, for example — while third-party games can take up even more space (Cyberpunk 2077 is 60GB). Until recently, the Switch 2 was one of the few devices that could take advantage of the faster MicroSD Express standard, but this year’s Asus ROG Ally X20 also added support for MicroSD Express. While expensive, the latter is an impressive gaming handheld that runs Windows 11, giving it a versatility that’s hard to find elsewhere.

chineseContent: 您的 Nintendo Switch 2 空间不足？值得庆幸的是，三星的 P9 MicroSD Express 卡在多家零售商处有折扣，256GB 版本售价 47.99 美元（亚马逊，B&H Photo），512GB 版本售价 99 美元（亚马逊，B&H Photo）。较小的卡通常售价约为 80 美元，较大的卡通常售价在 150 至 200 美元之间，不过两者都高于最初的发行价格，可能是因为内存持续短缺。 [产品：三星 P9 microSD Express 卡 | https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0FT99KCV8?tag=theverge02-20，https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0FT995SPF?tag=theverge02-20， https://go.skimresources.com/?id=87443X1797501&xs=1&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.bhphotovideo.com%2Fc%2Fproduct%2F1924975-REG%2Fsamsung_mb_mk256t_am_256gb_p9_microsd_express.html] 第一方 Switch 2 游戏每个游戏的运行空间通常在 10 到 30 GB 之间（例如，即将推出的《塞尔达传说：时之笛》重制版为 27 GB），而第三方游戏可能会占用更多空间（《赛博朋克 2077》为 60 GB）。直到最近，Switch 2 还是少数能够利用更快的 MicroSD Express 标准的设备之一，但今年的华硕 ROG Ally X20 也增加了对 MicroSD Express 的支持。虽然价格昂贵，但后者是一款令人印象深刻的游戏掌上电脑，运行 Windows 11，赋予它在其他地方很难找到的多功能性。
